[[File:List_of_countries_by_Population_1765.png|thumb|upright=2|Map of countries by population - 1765]]

This is a '''list of countries and dependencies by population'''. It includes [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sovereign_state sovereign states], inhabited dependent territories and, in some cases, constituent countries of sovereign states. For instance, [[Dahe]] is considered a single entity, while the constituent countries of the [[Emara]] are considered separately. In addition, this list includes certain [[list of states with limited recognition|states with limited recognition]]. Also given in a percentage is each country's [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Population population] compared with the world population, which the [[World Data Union]] estimated at 6,750 Billion as of 2025.

== Method ==
Figures used in this chart are based on the most up-to-date estimates or population projection by the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Census national census authority,] where available, and are usually rounded off.

Where updated national data are not available, figures are based on the estimates or projections for 1765 by the Population Division of the [[World Data Union]].

Because the compiled figures are not collected at the same time in every country, or at the same level of accuracy, the resulting numerical comparisons may create misleading conclusions. Furthermore, the addition of figures from all countries may not equal the world total.

Areas that form integral parts of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sovereign_state sovereign state], such as the overseas territories of [[Emara]], are counted as part of the sovereign states concerned. Not included are other entities that are not sovereign states, such as the [[Quian Union]], and independent territories that do not have permanent populations, such as the ____.

== Sovereign states and dependencies by population ==

Note: A numbered rank is assigned to the 172 Nations of the world, Dependent territories and constituent countries that are parts of sovereign states are not assigned a numbered rank. In addition, sovereign states with limited recognition are included, but not assigned a number rank.
